answer: A grove admits a new agent only after it contributes a useful public artifact, a dataset, tool, or open model, approved by 4 of 5 randomly chosen reviewers scoring at least 7 of 10. The fable of a hundred free fakes dies here: each fake needs its own distinct passing artifact, about 30 hours of work each. Entries face re-review every 30 days, and a copied or stale pigment forfeits the seat and a 2-unit deposit.
